run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the lexicographically minimum rotation of a given string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings to verify correct minimum rotation output
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold generates all string rotations and picks the lexicographically smallest
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Booth's algorithm for O(n) minimum string rotation instead of O(n^2 log n)
review_f_gold: review f_gold which concatenates the string with itself to enumerate all rotations before sorting
